say:3:1641104002:1.text: Uh... I'm Pippa. Are we... related? Something about you feels strangely familiar...
say:3:1641104002:1.source_cn: 呃，我叫皮帕。咱们……是亲戚吗？总感觉哪里怪怪的……

say:4:1641104003:1.text: Probably the tail. We've both got them—you just have an extra. And wow, yours looks like caramel cotton candy.
say:4:1641104003:1.source_cn: 你比我多了一条毛茸茸的尾巴呀！像蓬松的焦糖味云朵。

say:5:1641104004:1.text: Miss Pippa, would you mind if I gave it a pat? I'll trade you this acorn!
say:5:1641104004:1.source_cn: 皮帕小姐，我可以摸摸吗，作为交换，这个橡果给你！
